```{r}
# --- figure output redirected to _organized/figures/ ---
# Data files and CSV/RDS outputs keep their original paths.
fig_dir <- "../../../figures/data_analysis/ex_cat_matrix"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

folder_path <- "../../project1_ex/cat"

csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

output_file <- csv_files[grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files)]
data_files  <- csv_files[!grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files)]

# Read output.csv
output <- read.csv(output_file, header = TRUE)
cat("output loaded: ", nrow(output), "rows, ", ncol(output), "columns\n")

# Do not skip rows, read directly
for (i in seq_along(data_files)) {
  tryCatch({
    dat <- read.csv(data_files[i], header = TRUE)  # Remove skip = 1
    assign(paste0("dat_", i), dat)
    cat(paste0("dat_", i, " loaded: ", basename(data_files[i]),
               " (", nrow(dat), " rows, ", ncol(dat), " columns) \n"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste0("Skip: ", basename(data_files[i]), " -> ", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}
rm(dat)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# =========================================================
# Step 1. Build the RT matrix (rows = Video, columns = participant)
# If a Video × participant pair has multiple trials, take the mean
# =========================================================
rt_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_8.rt) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_8.rt)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = participant,
    values_from = key_resp_8.rt,
    values_fn   = mean
  )

rt_matrix <- rt_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("RT matrix dimensions: ", dim(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of videos: ", nrow(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of participants: ", ncol(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of missing values: ", sum(is.na(rt_matrix)), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 2. Z-score each column within participant
# Remove overall speed differences between participants
# =========================================================
rt_zscored <- scale(rt_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# Remove columns with no information after standardization
keep_cols <- colSums(!is.na(rt_zscored)) > 1
rt_zscored <- rt_zscored[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat("Matrix dimensions after standardization: ", dim(rt_zscored), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 3. Calculate the RDM
# Compute pairwise dissimilarity between videos
# correlation distance = 1 - Pearson correlation
# =========================================================
rdm_rt <- 1 - cor(
  t(rt_zscored),
  method = "pearson",
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# Ensure row and column names use Video IDs
rownames(rdm_rt) <- rownames(rt_zscored)
colnames(rdm_rt) <- rownames(rt_zscored)

cat("RDM dimensions: ", dim(rdm_rt), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 4. Visualize
# =========================================================
pheatmap(
  rdm_rt,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "Human RDM - RT"
)

# =========================================================
# Step 5. Save
# =========================================================
saveRDS(rdm_rt, "human_rdm_rt.rds")
write.csv(rdm_rt, "human_rdm_rt.csv")
```

corr_rdm
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# =========================================================
# Step 1. Build the correctness matrix (rows = Video, columns = participant)
# If a Video × participant pair has multiple trials, take the mean
# Each cell represents a participant's accuracy for that video
# =========================================================
corr_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_8.corr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_8.corr)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = participant,
    values_from = key_resp_8.corr,
    values_fn   = mean
  )

corr_matrix <- corr_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("Correctness matrix dimensions: ", dim(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of videos: ", nrow(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of participants: ", ncol(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of missing values: ", sum(is.na(corr_matrix)), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 2. Calculate the RDM
# Use mean absolute difference (suitable for binary or proportion-correct data)
# d(i,j) = mean(|x_i - x_j|)
# =========================================================
video_ids <- rownames(corr_matrix)
n_video <- nrow(corr_matrix)

rdm_corr <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = n_video,
  ncol = n_video,
  dimnames = list(video_ids, video_ids)
)

for (i in seq_len(n_video)) {
  for (j in i:n_video) {
    xi <- corr_matrix[i, ]
    xj <- corr_matrix[j, ]

    keep <- !is.na(xi) & !is.na(xj)

    if (sum(keep) == 0) {
      d <- NA_real_
    } else {
      d <- mean(abs(xi[keep] - xj[keep]))
    }

    rdm_corr[i, j] <- d
    rdm_corr[j, i] <- d
  }
}

cat("RDM dimensions: ", dim(rdm_corr), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 3. Visualize
# =========================================================
pheatmap(
  rdm_corr,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "Human RDM - Correctness"
)

# =========================================================
# Step 4. Save
# =========================================================
save_path <- "."

if (!dir.exists(save_path)) {
  dir.create(save_path, recursive = TRUE)
}

saveRDS(rdm_corr, file.path(save_path, "human_rdm_corr.rds"))
write.csv(rdm_corr, file.path(save_path, "human_rdm_corr.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(corr_wide, file.path(save_path, "corr_wide.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ── Step 1: Build the RT matrix (rows=video, columns=participant) ──────────
rt_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_8.rt) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_8.rt)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = participant,
              values_from = key_resp_8.rt,
              values_fn   = mean)

rt_matrix <- rt_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("RT matrix dimensions: ", dim(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of videos: ", nrow(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of participants: ", ncol(rt_matrix), "\n")

# Check missing values
cat("Number of missing values: ", sum(is.na(rt_matrix)), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ── Step 2: Compute by column z-score ──────────────────────────
rt_zscored <- scale(rt_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# ── Step 3: Run PCA ───────────────────────────────────
pca_rt <- prcomp(rt_zscored, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# ── Step 4: Inspect explained variance ──────────────────────────────
var_explained <- summary(pca_rt)$importance
cat("=== Variance explained by each PC ===\n")
print(round(var_explained[, 1:10], 3))

# Find the number of PCs needed to explain 80% and 90% of the variance
cum_var <- cumsum(pca_rt$sdev^2 / sum(pca_rt$sdev^2))
k_80 <- which(cum_var >= 0.80)[1]
k_90 <- which(cum_var >= 0.90)[1]
cat("\nExplaining 80% of the variance requires ", k_80, " PC\n")
cat("Explaining 90% of the variance requires ", k_90, " PC\n")

# ── Step 5: Visualize explained variance ───────────────────────────
plot(cum_var, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of PCs",
     ylab = "Cumulative Variance Explained",
     main = "CAT - RT PCA")
abline(h = 0.80, col = "blue", lty = 2)
abline(h = 0.90, col = "red",  lty = 2)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("80%", "90%"),
       col    = c("blue", "red"),
       lty    = 2)

# ── Step 6: Scores for each video on each PC ──────────────
pc_scores <- pca_rt$x
cat("\n=== Video PC scores (first 5 rows and first 5 PCs) ===\n")
print(round(pc_scores[1:5, 1:5], 3))

# ── Step 7: Videos with the highest and lowest scores on each PC ────────────
cat("\n=== Highest- and lowest-scoring videos for each PC ===\n")
for (k in 1:k_90) {
  scores <- pc_scores[, k]
  top3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
  bot3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:3]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  highest: ", paste(top3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  lowest: ", paste(bot3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r}
save_path <- "."
# ── Step 2: Compute by column z-score ──────────────────────────
rt_zscored <- scale(rt_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# ── Step 3: Run PCA ───────────────────────────────────
pca_rt <- prcomp(rt_zscored, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# ── Step 4: Inspect explained variance ──────────────────────────────
var_explained <- summary(pca_rt)$importance
cat("=== Variance explained by each PC ===\n")
print(round(var_explained[, 1:10], 3))

cum_var <- cumsum(pca_rt$sdev^2 / sum(pca_rt$sdev^2))
k_80 <- which(cum_var >= 0.80)[1]
k_90 <- which(cum_var >= 0.90)[1]
cat("\nExplaining 80% of the variance requires ", k_80, " PC\n")
cat("Explaining 90% of the variance requires ", k_90, " PC\n")

# ── Step 5: Scree plot (ggplot version) ────────────────────
var_df <- data.frame(
  PC  = 1:length(cum_var),
  cum = cum_var
)

p_scree <- ggplot(var_df, aes(x = PC, y = cum)) +
  geom_point(color = "#4DBBD5", size = 1.5) +
  geom_line(color  = "#4DBBD5", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "blue", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.90, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "red",  linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = k_80, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "blue", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = k_90, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "red",  linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = k_80 + 1, y = 0.72,
           label = paste0("k=", k_80), color = "blue", size = 2.5, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = k_90 + 1, y = 0.82,
           label = paste0("k=", k_90), color = "red",  size = 2.5, hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "CAT - RT PCA",
       x = "Number of PCs",
       y = "Cumulative Variance Explained") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text          = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.line          = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

print(p_scree)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "ex_cat_RT_PCA_scree.pdf"),
  plot = p_scree, width = 90, height = 80, units = "mm",
  dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "ex_cat_RT_PCA_scree.png"),
  plot = p_scree, width = 90, height = 80, units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)
cat("Scree Plot saved!\n")
```

Formal Experiment CAT RT PCA:

PC1 explains 13.5% of the variance (17.7% in the pilot study).
Explaining 80% of the variance requires 27 PCs (the pilot study required only 14).
Explaining 90% of the variance requires 35 PCs (the pilot study required only 18).
The curve is extremely flat, almost linear

```{r}
library(logisticPCA)
save_path <- "."
# ── Step 1: Build the correctness matrix ────────────────────
corr_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_8.corr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_8.corr)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = participant,
              values_from = key_resp_8.corr,
              values_fn   = mean)

corr_matrix <- corr_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("Correctness matrix dimensions: ", dim(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of missing values: ", sum(is.na(corr_matrix)), "\n")

# ── Step 2: Select the optimal k by cross-validation ────────────────
logpca_cv <- cv.lpca(corr_matrix, ks = 1:10, ms = 4)
plot(logpca_cv)
k_opt <- which.min(rowMeans(logpca_cv))
cat("optimal k: ", k_opt, "\n")

# ── Step 3: Run logistic PCA ───────────────────────────
logpca_model <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k_opt, m = 4)

# ── Step 4: PC scores for each video ───────────────────────
pc_scores_corr <- logpca_model$PCs
rownames(pc_scores_corr) <- rownames(corr_matrix)

cat("\n=== Highest- and lowest-scoring videos for each PC ===\n")
for (k in 1:k_opt) {
  scores <- pc_scores_corr[, k]
  top10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
  bot10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:10]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  highest: ", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  lowest: ", paste(bot10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ── Step 5: Variance explained ──────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Variance explained ===\n")
var_exp <- logpca_model$prop_deviance_expl
cat("Proportion of Variance explained by each PC: \n")
print(round(var_exp, 3))

# ── Step 6: Save ─────────────────────────────────────
pc_scores_corr_df <- as.data.frame(pc_scores_corr)
pc_scores_corr_df$Video <- rownames(corr_matrix)
pc_scores_corr_df <- pc_scores_corr_df %>% dplyr::select(Video, everything())

write.csv(pc_scores_corr_df,
          file.path(save_path, "cat_correctness_logisticPCA_scores.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nComplete: logistic PCA scores saved\n")
```

```{r}
loadings_corr <- as.data.frame(logpca_model$U)
colnames(loadings_corr) <- paste0("PC", 1:k_opt)
loadings_corr$participant <- colnames(corr_matrix)
loadings_corr <- loadings_corr %>% dplyr::select(participant, everything())

cat("Logistic PCA Loadings matrix dimensions: ", dim(loadings_corr), "\n")

write.csv(loadings_corr,
          file.path(save_path, "cat_correctness_logisticPCA_loadings.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Logistic PCA Loadings saved!\n")
```

```{r}
# ── Step 5.5: Scree Plot ──────────────────────────────
max_k <- 20
var_by_k <- numeric(max_k)

for (k in 1:max_k) {
  m <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k, m = 4)
  var_by_k[k] <- m$prop_deviance_expl
}

# Incremental Variance explained by each PCs
marginal_var <- c(var_by_k[1], diff(var_by_k))

scree_df_corr <- data.frame(
  PC           = 1:max_k,
  Marginal_Var = marginal_var
)

p_scree_corr <- ggplot(scree_df_corr, aes(x = PC, y = Marginal_Var)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:max_k) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                     limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot - Correctness Logistic PCA",
       x = "Component Number",
       y = "Marginal Variance Explained") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.line   = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks  = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

print(p_scree_corr)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "correctness_logisticPCA_scree.pdf"),
  plot = p_scree_corr, width = 90, height = 80, units = "mm",
  dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "correctness_logisticPCA_scree.png"),
  plot = p_scree_corr, width = 90, height = 80, units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)
cat("Correctness Scree Plot saved!\n")
```

k=1 → k=2: the score drops rapidly
k=2 → k=3: the curve is nearly flat (local elbow)
k=3 → k=10: the score continues to decline

The k=2-3 plateau is a genuine elbow signal, indicating that the first 2-3 dimensions capture the primary structure while later dimensions add progressively finer detail.
```{r}
# Expand the k range and rerun cross-validation
logpca_cv2 <- cv.lpca(corr_matrix, ks = 1:20, ms = 4)
plot(logpca_cv2)

# Inspect the elbow location manually
cv_means <- rowMeans(logpca_cv2)
cat("Cross-validation score for each k: \n")
print(round(cv_means, 2))

# Use the elbow rule to find the optimal k
# Calculate changes in slope
diffs <- diff(cv_means)
diffs2 <- diff(diffs)
k_elbow <- which.min(diffs2) + 1
cat("The elbow rule suggests k =", k_elbow, "\n")

# Alternatively, choose the smallest value that reaches 80% explained variance
# Rerun with different k values to inspect explained variance
for (k in c(3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20)) {
  m <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k, m = 4)
  cat(paste0("k=", k, ": Variance explained = ", round(m$prop_deviance_expl, 3), "\n"))
}
```

k=15 explains 77% of the variance, close to the 80% threshold.
The cross-validation curve flattens near k=15.

```{r}
make_readable_video_label <- function(video) {
  video_name <- clean_video_label(video)
  video_key <- substr(video_name, 1, 12)
  mapped <- video_readable_label_map[video_key]
  ifelse(is.na(mapped), video_key, mapped)
}

make_video_pc_table <- function(scores, pcs = 1:3, n_each_side = 10, pc_labels = NULL) {
  scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores)
  scores_df$Video <- rownames(scores_df)
  if (is.null(pc_labels)) {
    pc_labels <- setNames(paste0("PC", pcs), paste0("PC", pcs))
  }

  bind_rows(lapply(pcs, function(pc) {
    pc_col <- paste0("PC", pc)
    one_pc <- scores_df %>%
      dplyr::select(Video, score = all_of(pc_col)) %>%
      mutate(
        PC = pc_col,
        Dimension = pc_labels[pc_col],
        video_name = clean_video_label(Video),
        video_key = substr(video_name, 1, 12),
        video_label = make_readable_video_label(Video)
      )

    bind_rows(
      one_pc %>%
        arrange(desc(score)) %>%
        slice_head(n = n_each_side) %>%
        mutate(direction = "highest"),
      one_pc %>%
        arrange(score) %>%
        slice_head(n = n_each_side) %>%
        mutate(direction = "lowest")
    )
  })) %>%
    dplyr::select(PC, Dimension, direction, score, Video, video_key, video_label, video_name)
}

prepare_video_pc_scores <- function(scores, pc_labels = NULL, pc_short_labels = NULL) {
  scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores)

  if (!all(c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3") %in% colnames(scores_df))) {
    colnames(scores_df)[1:3] <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")
  }
  if (is.null(pc_labels)) {
    pc_labels <- c(PC1 = "PC1", PC2 = "PC2", PC3 = "PC3")
  }
  if (is.null(pc_short_labels)) {
    pc_short_labels <- pc_labels
  }

  scores_df <- scores_df %>%
    mutate(
      PC1_raw = PC1,
      PC2_raw = PC2,
      PC3_raw = PC3,
      PC1 = PC1_raw - mean(PC1_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      PC2 = PC2_raw - mean(PC2_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      PC3 = PC3_raw - mean(PC3_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Video = rownames(scores_df),
      video_name = clean_video_label(Video),
      video_key = substr(video_name, 1, 12),
      video_label = make_readable_video_label(Video),
      dominant_pc = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")[
        max.col(abs(cbind(PC1, PC2, PC3)), ties.method = "first")
      ],
      dominant_dimension = pc_labels[dominant_pc],
      dominant_short = pc_short_labels[dominant_pc],
      plot_label = paste0(dominant_short, "-", video_label),
      dominant_load = pmax(abs(PC1), abs(PC2), abs(PC3)),
      distance_pc123 = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2 + PC3^2)
    )

  scores_df$dominant_pc <- factor(scores_df$dominant_pc,
                                  levels = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"))
  scores_df$dominant_dimension <- factor(scores_df$dominant_dimension,
                                         levels = pc_labels[c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")])
  scores_df
}

make_pc123_flat_biplot <- function(scores_df,
                                   title,
                                   label_n = 12,
                                   pc3_angle = 45,
                                   pc3_scale = 0.45,
                                   point_size = 1.8,
                                   y_limits = NULL,
                                   y_break_by = NULL,
                                   coord_ratio = 1,
                                   x_expand = 0.005,
                                   y_expand = 0.005,
                                   label_below = character(),
                                   label_below_offset = 0.9,
                                   pc1_label_y_factor = 0.060,
                                   pc_labels = c(PC1 = "PC1", PC2 = "PC2", PC3 = "PC3"),
                                   legend_title = "Dominant Dimension") {
  pc_labels <- pc_labels[c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")]
  angle_rad <- pc3_angle * pi / 180
  pc3_x_unit <- cos(angle_rad)
  pc3_y_unit <- sin(angle_rad) / coord_ratio

  plot_df <- scores_df %>%
    mutate(
      plot_x = PC1 + pc3_scale * PC3 * pc3_x_unit,
      plot_y = PC2 + pc3_scale * PC3 * pc3_y_unit,
      dominant_dimension = factor(pc_labels[as.character(dominant_pc)],
                                  levels = pc_labels)
    )
  pc_color_values <- setNames(c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "#009E73"), pc_labels)
  pc_fill_values <- setNames(c("#F4A582", "#92C5DE", "#A6DBA0"), pc_labels)

  axis_len <- max(abs(c(plot_df$plot_x, plot_df$plot_y)), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.92
  y_axis_len <- if (!is.null(y_limits) && !is.na(y_limits[2])) {
    min(axis_len, y_limits[2] * 0.82)
  } else {
    axis_len
  }
  pc3_axis_len <- if (!is.null(y_limits) && !is.na(y_limits[2])) {
    min(axis_len * 0.72, y_limits[2] * 0.72 / pc3_y_unit)
  } else {
    axis_len * 0.72
  }
  axis_df <- tibble(
    axis = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"),
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    xend = c(axis_len, 0, pc3_axis_len * pc3_x_unit),
    yend = c(0, y_axis_len, pc3_axis_len * pc3_y_unit),
    label_x = c(axis_len * 0.72, -axis_len * 0.105, pc3_axis_len * pc3_x_unit * 1.02),
    label_y = c(axis_len * pc1_label_y_factor, y_axis_len * 0.94, pc3_axis_len * pc3_y_unit * 1.10),
    label = c(
      paste0("Dim 1\n", pc_labels["PC1"]),
      paste0("Dim 2\n", pc_labels["PC2"]),
      paste0("Dim 3\n", pc_labels["PC3"], " (45 deg)")
    ),
    hjust = c(0, 1, 0),
    vjust = c(0, 0, 0.5)
  )

  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    arrange(desc(dominant_load)) %>%
    slice_head(n = label_n)
  manual_label_df <- label_df %>%
    filter(video_key %in% label_below) %>%
    mutate(label_y = plot_y - label_below_offset)
  label_df <- label_df %>%
    filter(!video_key %in% label_below)

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = plot_x, y = plot_y, color = dominant_dimension)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      geom = "polygon", type = "norm", level = 0.68,
      aes(fill = dominant_dimension),
      alpha = 0.22, linewidth = 0.7,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = axis_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm")),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = axis_df,
      aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = label, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.85, color = "black", lineheight = 0.90
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.86) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = plot_label),
      size = 2.8,
      color = "black",
      box.padding = 0.25,
      point.padding = 0.18,
      segment.color = "grey55",
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = manual_label_df,
      aes(x = plot_x, y = label_y, label = plot_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.8,
      color = "black",
      vjust = 1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pc_color_values) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pc_fill_values) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = x_expand)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = y_expand),
      breaks = if (!is.null(y_break_by) && !is.null(y_limits) && all(!is.na(y_limits))) {
        seq(y_limits[1], y_limits[2], by = y_break_by)
      } else {
        waiver()
      },
      minor_breaks = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = paste0("Dim 1: ", pc_labels["PC1"]),
      y = paste0("Dim 2: ", pc_labels["PC2"]),
      color = legend_title,
      fill = legend_title
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = coord_ratio, ylim = y_limits, clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey94", linewidth = 0.25),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "mm"),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 4, 10, unit = "mm")
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        nrow = 1,
        override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 3, alpha = 1)
      ),
      fill = "none"
    )

  p
}
```

```{r}
# ── Video-by-video RSM heatmaps ────────────────────────
# This plot is a pairwise similarity matrix across videos.
# An RSM/RDM is more appropriate for this visualization than PCA.
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

save_path <- "."

clean_video_label <- function(video) {
  substr(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(video)), 1, 10)
}

clean_video_key <- function(video) {
  substr(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(video)), 1, 12)
}

read_rsm_label_info <- function(path) {
  read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      video_key = if ("video_key" %in% names(.)) video_key else clean_video_key(Video),
      video_label = if ("video_label" %in% names(.)) video_label else clean_video_key(Video),
      dominant_short = if ("dominant_short" %in% names(.)) dominant_short else dominant_pc,
      dominant_dimension = if ("dominant_dimension" %in% names(.)) dominant_dimension else dominant_pc,
      rsm_label = if ("plot_label" %in% names(.)) plot_label else paste0(dominant_short, "-", video_label),
      dominant_score = case_when(
        dominant_pc == "PC1" ~ PC1,
        dominant_pc == "PC2" ~ PC2,
        dominant_pc == "PC3" ~ PC3,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(video_key, video_label, dominant_pc, dominant_dimension,
                  dominant_short, rsm_label, dominant_load, dominant_score) %>%
    distinct(video_key, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

make_grouped_video_order <- function(similarity_matrix,
                                     label_info = NULL,
                                     group_by_pc = FALSE,
                                     order_mode = c("hclust", "pc", "pc_strength", "strength"),
                                     edge_low_outliers = FALSE) {
  order_mode <- match.arg(order_mode)
  video_names <- rownames(similarity_matrix)

  if (order_mode == "strength") {
    strength_matrix <- similarity_matrix
    diag(strength_matrix) <- NA_real_
    similarity_strength <- rowMeans(strength_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
    return(names(sort(similarity_strength, decreasing = FALSE)))
  }

  if (is.null(label_info) || !group_by_pc || !(order_mode %in% c("pc", "pc_strength"))) {
    video_dist <- as.dist(1 - similarity_matrix)
    video_hclust <- hclust(video_dist, method = "average")
    return(video_hclust$labels[video_hclust$order])
  }

  video_meta <- tibble(Video = video_names, video_key = clean_video_key(video_names)) %>%
    left_join(label_info, by = "video_key")
  all_similarity_matrix <- similarity_matrix
  diag(all_similarity_matrix) <- NA_real_
  all_video_similarity <- rowMeans(all_similarity_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

  group_levels <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")
  edge_red_outlier <- character(0)
  edge_light_outliers <- character(0)

  if (edge_low_outliers) {
    sorted_strength <- sort(all_video_similarity[video_names], decreasing = FALSE)
    edge_red_outlier <- names(sorted_strength)[1]

    if (length(sorted_strength) > 3) {
      remaining_strength <- sorted_strength[-1]
      strength_gaps <- diff(as.numeric(remaining_strength))
      largest_gap <- which.max(strength_gaps)

      if (length(largest_gap) &&
          !is.na(strength_gaps[largest_gap]) &&
          strength_gaps[largest_gap] > 0.03) {
        edge_light_outliers <- names(remaining_strength)[seq_len(largest_gap)]
      }
    }

    red_pc <- video_meta$dominant_pc[match(edge_red_outlier, video_meta$Video)]
    light_pc <- video_meta$dominant_pc[match(tail(edge_light_outliers, 1), video_meta$Video)]
    red_pc <- as.character(red_pc[!is.na(red_pc)])
    light_pc <- as.character(light_pc[!is.na(light_pc)])

    first_pc <- if (length(red_pc) > 0) red_pc[1] else character(0)
    last_pc <- if (length(light_pc) > 0) light_pc[1] else character(0)
    group_levels <- unique(c(first_pc, setdiff(group_levels, c(first_pc, last_pc)), last_pc))
  }

  grouped_order <- unlist(lapply(group_levels, function(one_pc) {
    group_videos <- video_meta %>%
      filter(dominant_pc == one_pc) %>%
      pull(Video)

    group_edge_first <- intersect(edge_red_outlier, group_videos)
    group_edge_last <- intersect(edge_light_outliers, group_videos)
    finish_group_order <- function(group_order) {
      c(
        group_edge_first,
        setdiff(group_order, c(group_edge_first, group_edge_last)),
        group_edge_last
      )
    }

    if (length(group_videos) <= 1) {
      return(finish_group_order(group_videos))
    }

    group_sim <- similarity_matrix[group_videos, group_videos, drop = FALSE]
    group_sim <- (group_sim + t(group_sim)) / 2
    diag(group_sim) <- 1

    own_group_similarity <- sapply(group_videos, function(one_video) {
      mean(group_sim[one_video, setdiff(group_videos, one_video)], na.rm = TRUE)
    })

    if (length(group_videos) <= 2) {
      ranking_similarity <- if (order_mode == "pc_strength") {
        all_video_similarity[group_videos]
      } else {
        own_group_similarity
      }
      return(finish_group_order(names(sort(ranking_similarity, decreasing = order_mode == "pc"))))
    }

    if (order_mode == "pc_strength") {
      return(finish_group_order(names(sort(all_video_similarity[group_videos], decreasing = FALSE))))
    }

    group_dist <- as.dist(1 - group_sim)
    group_hclust <- hclust(group_dist, method = "average")
    ordered_group <- group_hclust$labels[group_hclust$order]

    if (own_group_similarity[ordered_group[1]] < own_group_similarity[ordered_group[length(ordered_group)]]) {
      ordered_group <- rev(ordered_group)
    }

    finish_group_order(ordered_group)
  }), use.names = FALSE)

  ordered_videos <- c(grouped_order, setdiff(video_names, grouped_order))

  ordered_videos
}

make_rsm_plot <- function(rdm,
                          title,
                          output_stub,
                          similarity_type = c("cor_rescaled", "one_minus_distance"),
                          plot_type = c("similarity", "rt_rdm"),
                          palette = c("blue", "rt"),
                          label_info = NULL,
                          group_by_pc = FALSE,
                          order_mode = c("hclust", "pc", "pc_strength", "strength"),
                          edge_low_outliers = FALSE) {
  similarity_type <- match.arg(similarity_type)
  plot_type <- match.arg(plot_type)
  palette <- match.arg(palette)
  order_mode <- match.arg(order_mode)

  if (plot_type == "rt_rdm") {
    rdm_offdiag <- rdm[upper.tri(rdm)]
    rdm_min <- min(rdm_offdiag, na.rm = TRUE)
    rdm_max <- max(rdm_offdiag, na.rm = TRUE)
    scaled_dissimilarity <- (rdm - rdm_min) / (rdm_max - rdm_min)
    plot_matrix <- 1 - scaled_dissimilarity
    diag(plot_matrix) <- 1
    plot_matrix[plot_matrix < 0] <- 0
    plot_matrix[plot_matrix > 1] <- 1
    fill_label <- "Similarity"
    plot_offdiag <- plot_matrix[upper.tri(plot_matrix)]
    fill_colours <- c("#D73027", "#F46D43", "#FDAE61", "#FFFFBF", "#D1E5F0", "#67A9CF", "#2166AC")
    fill_values <- seq(0, 1, length.out = length(fill_colours))
    fill_limits <- c(0, 1)
    fill_breaks <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  } else {
    if (similarity_type == "cor_rescaled") {
      # For RT, RDM = 1 - Pearson r; recover r and rescale it to 0-1 for RSM plotting.
      plot_matrix <- (1 - rdm + 1) / 2
      fill_label <- "Similarity\n(rescaled r)"
    } else {
      # For correctness, the RDM is the mean absolute difference; 1 - distance gives 0-1 similarity.
      plot_matrix <- 1 - rdm
      fill_label <- "Similarity"
    }

    diag(plot_matrix) <- 1
    plot_matrix[plot_matrix < 0] <- 0
    plot_matrix[plot_matrix > 1] <- 1
    plot_offdiag <- plot_matrix[upper.tri(plot_matrix)]
    if (palette == "rt") {
      fill_colours <- c("#D73027", "#F46D43", "#FDAE61", "#FFFFBF", "#D1E5F0", "#67A9CF", "#2166AC")
      fill_values <- seq(0, 1, length.out = length(fill_colours))
    } else {
      fill_colours <- c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#2171B5", "#08519C", "#08306B")
      fill_values <- scales::rescale(c(0, as.numeric(quantile(
        plot_offdiag,
        probs = c(0.05, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )), 1), from = c(0, 1))
    }
    fill_limits <- c(0, 1)
    fill_breaks <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  }

  video_order <- make_grouped_video_order(
    plot_matrix,
    label_info = label_info,
    group_by_pc = group_by_pc,
    order_mode = order_mode,
    edge_low_outliers = edge_low_outliers
  )
  if (is.null(label_info)) {
    label_info <- tibble(
      video_key = character(),
      video_label = character(),
      dominant_pc = character(),
      dominant_dimension = character(),
      dominant_short = character(),
      rsm_label = character()
    )
  }
  video_meta <- tibble(Video = rownames(rdm), video_key = clean_video_key(rownames(rdm))) %>%
    left_join(label_info, by = "video_key") %>%
    mutate(
      rsm_label = ifelse(is.na(rsm_label), clean_video_label(Video), rsm_label),
      dominant_dimension = ifelse(is.na(dominant_dimension), "Ungrouped", dominant_dimension)
    )
  label_lookup <- setNames(video_meta$rsm_label, video_meta$Video)

  ordered_meta <- video_meta %>%
    mutate(Video = factor(Video, levels = video_order)) %>%
    arrange(Video)
  group_runs <- rle(ordered_meta$dominant_dimension)
  group_sizes <- tibble(
    dominant_dimension = group_runs$values,
    n = group_runs$lengths
  ) %>%
    filter(dominant_dimension != "Ungrouped")
  group_boxes <- if (nrow(group_sizes) > 0 && group_by_pc) {
    group_sizes %>%
      mutate(
        group_end = cumsum(n),
        group_start = group_end - n + 1,
        xmin = group_start - 0.5,
        xmax = group_end + 0.5,
        ymin = length(video_order) - group_end + 0.5,
        ymax = length(video_order) - group_start + 1.5
      )
  } else {
    tibble()
  }
  group_boundaries <- if (nrow(group_sizes) > 1 && group_by_pc) {
    cumsum(group_sizes$n)[-nrow(group_sizes)] + 0.5
  } else {
    numeric(0)
  }
  y_group_boundaries <- length(video_order) - group_boundaries + 1

  sim_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(plot_matrix)) %>%
    rename(Video_1 = Var1, Video_2 = Var2, Matrix_value = Freq) %>%
    mutate(
      Video_1 = factor(Video_1, levels = rev(video_order)),
      Video_2 = factor(Video_2, levels = video_order),
      label_1 = label_lookup[as.character(Video_1)],
      label_2 = label_lookup[as.character(Video_2)]
    )

  p <- ggplot(sim_df, aes(x = Video_2, y = Video_1, fill = Matrix_value)) +
    geom_tile(color = NA) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = fill_colours,
      values = fill_values,
      limits = fill_limits,
      breaks = fill_breaks,
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = fill_label
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) label_lookup[x], expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) label_lookup[x], expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 4.5, angle = 55, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, unit = "mm")
    )

  if (nrow(group_boxes) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_rect(
        data = group_boxes,
        aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        fill = NA,
        color = "white",
        linewidth = 0.85
      )
  }

  print(p)

  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_stub, ".pdf")),
         p, width = 155, height = 145, units = "mm",
         dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_stub, ".png")),
         p, width = 155, height = 145, units = "mm",
         dpi = 300)

  write.csv(plot_matrix[video_order, video_order],
            file.path(save_path, paste0(output_stub, "_matrix.csv")),
            row.names = TRUE)
  write.csv(ordered_meta %>%
              mutate(
                plot_order = row_number(),
                Video = as.character(Video)
              ) %>%
              dplyr::select(plot_order, everything()),
            file.path(save_path, paste0(output_stub, "_video_labels.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
}

rdm_rt_for_rsm <- if (exists("rdm_rt")) {
  rdm_rt
} else {
  readRDS(file.path(save_path, "human_rdm_rt.rds"))
}

rdm_corr_for_rsm <- if (exists("rdm_corr")) {
  rdm_corr
} else {
  readRDS(file.path(save_path, "human_rdm_corr.rds"))
}

rt_rsm_label_info <- read_rsm_label_info(
  file.path(save_path, "cat_RT_PCA_video_scores_PC1_PC2_PC3_dominant_color.csv")
)
corr_rsm_label_info <- read_rsm_label_info(
  file.path(save_path, "cat_correctness_logisticPCA_video_scores_PC1_PC2_PC3_dominant_color.csv")
)

make_rsm_plot(
  rdm = rdm_rt_for_rsm,
  title = "Semantic - RT Video RSM",
  output_stub = "cat_RT_video_RSM",
  similarity_type = "cor_rescaled",
  plot_type = "rt_rdm",
  label_info = rt_rsm_label_info,
  group_by_pc = TRUE,
  order_mode = "pc"
)

make_rsm_plot(
  rdm = rdm_corr_for_rsm,
  title = "Semantic - Correctness Video RSM",
  output_stub = "cat_correctness_video_RSM",
  similarity_type = "one_minus_distance",
  palette = "rt",
  label_info = corr_rsm_label_info,
  group_by_pc = TRUE,
  order_mode = "pc",
  edge_low_outliers = TRUE
)

cat("Video-by-video RSM heatmaps saved!\n")
```
